description: Prepare a person's own event on Pandy Tickets from what they told you (name, date, place, ticket categories with price and quantity). Nothing is published and no account is created: it returns a one-time claim_url, valid 48 hours. The person opens it, signs in with Google, and lands on a screen where they review the event and publish it with one click. Use it when someone wants to organize an event and sell tickets or take registrations. Leave ticket_types empty for a free event. Also fill in, when the person said them: questions to ask each attendee, early-bird price_phases, and transfer_instructions (bank details) so the person only reviews and publishes. Relay the Spanish instructions and the link.

accent_color.description: Brand colour as #RRGGBB, if the person gave one.

capacity.description: Most people the event takes in total, if there is a limit.

description.description: What the event is about, up to 5000 characters.

end_at.description: End, Guatemala local time, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM, after start_at.

price_phases.description: Early-bird style price phases, in order, up to 10. The first phase that has not ended applies. Needs paid ticket_types; a free event has no prices to phase.

ends_at.description: When the phase ends, Guatemala local time, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM. Omit if it ends only when its quantity sells out.

name.description: Phase name, e.g. "Preventa", up to 60 characters.

prices.description: Object mapping a ticket_types name (any letter case) to the price in quetzales in this phase, e.g. {"General": "100"}. A category left out keeps its base price.

quantity.description: Tickets sold in this phase before the next one starts.

questions.description: Questions every attendee answers when registering or buying, up to 15. Works for free and paid events.

label.description: The question as the attendee reads it, up to 160 characters.

options.description: Only for kind choice: 2 to 20 distinct answers, up to 100 characters each.

start_at.description: Start, Guatemala local time, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM. Must be in the future.

theme.description: Look of the event page, checkout, emails and tickets. pandy: El estilo de Pandy Tickets. Sirve para cualquier evento. gala: Para recitales, galas, bodas y cenas benéficas. deportivo: Para carreras, torneos y rodadas. academico: Para congresos, simposios y graduaciones. festival: Para conciertos, fiestas y vida nocturna. comunidad: Para shows infantiles y eventos de colegio o iglesia. minimal: Para talleres y eventos corporativos. Tu foto manda. Pick the one that matches the event. Default: the organizer's last look, else pandy.

theme_tone.description: Light or dark version of a look that has both (gala). auto follows the event image: light image, light page. Default: the organizer's last choice, else auto.

ticket_types.description: Paid ticket categories. Empty or omitted for a free event.

price.description: Price in quetzales, e.g. "150" or "75.50". At least 0.01.

title_font.description: Title font. Omit to use the look's own font.

transfer_instructions.description: Bank, account number and holder for paying by bank transfer, 10 to 2000 characters. The person sees it prefilled when publishing.

venue.description: Place or city, up to 240 characters.
